snippet.title: Eden Crafters – Official 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Eden Crafters – Launching May 7, 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/

After an incredible Early Access journey, Eden Crafters is reaching its full 1.0 release, featuring more content, deeper systems, and a complete gameplay experience.

- Explore and transform 5 unique planets
- Build powerful machines and automate your production
- Unlock new terraforming goals — including the arrival of birds
- Discover new vehicles and equipment
- Customize your bases with decorative items
- Enjoy improved automation systems
- Unlock 39 Steam achievements

Eden Crafters is a solo or co-op open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity. Build, automate, and terraform. Control the climate, create a breathable atmosphere, and turn toxic lakes into water: shape a new world! 

Available May 7, 2026 on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570210/Eden_Crafters/
